title: Sis Bates Shares Her Mother’s Ovarian Cancer Journey
summary: Learn how AI-powered pre-screening helps pathology teams reduce IHC turnaround times, decrease unnecessary staining, and improve workflow efficiency while supporting diagnostic quality
body_markdown:
**Identifying ovarian cancer symptoms: How AUSL athlete Sis Bates is emphasizing the importance of preventive care**


Portland Cascade infielder Sis Bates has always looked up to her mother.


"My mom is my biggest fan, and I'm hers," she says. From being her first coach to supporting every step of her softball journey, Sis describes her mom as one of the strongest and most influential people in her life.


That support took on a new meaning when her mother began experiencing stomach pain, one of several potential ovarian cancer symptoms, and decided to get it checked. Sis knew something was wrong because her mother rarely went to the doctor.


Additional testing, including a CA-125 blood test used as part of the[ovarian cancer](https://www.labcorp.com/oncology/providers/testing-solutions/solid-tumor/ovarian-cancer) evaluation, helped confirm the diagnosis.


**The power of community**


"It's very hard, and there's nothing that can prepare you for it," Sis says. As her family navigated her mother’s diagnosis, she learned that caring for her mother also means knowing when to lean on others for support.


"Have your people that you can unleash on, so that you can go be the best version of yourself for the person you're caring for."


**Encouraging others to take action**


While sharing her story isn't easy, Sis hopes it will encourage people to talk to their healthcare providers, take advantage of preventive care, and get checked sooner.


"If something feels off, please just go get it checked," she says. "There's no harm in finding out." ****


**The role of testing**


Labcorp is working with the Athletes Unlimited Softball League (AUSL) to advance women’s health and support athlete well-being. As part of this collaboration, we're sharing stories from players about the role testing has played in their lives and how it can help you better understand your health. Sis's story is a reminder that getting answers often starts with taking the first step.
